about.label: About Me
about.heading: Bridging Logic & Creativity
bio: I'm a passionate Fullstack Developer based in Vietnam with over 3 years of programming experience, specializing in building responsive, high-performance web applications. I love turning complex problems into simple, elegant solutions.

I've worked on diverse projects ranging from e-commerce platforms and AI-powered services to Amazon seller tools. I'm always eager to learn new technologies and take on challenging projects that push my skills to the next level.

proj1.title: Peraichi E-Commerce Platform
proj1.description: A web platform enabling users to create online seller websites with product management, payments, and e-commerce operations. Includes AI service for auto-generating landing pages and CRM system.

proj2.title: AIHELLO - Amazon Seller Tools
proj2.description: A web platform designed to assist Amazon sellers in developing and managing products, including campaign and event management for individual listings.

proj3.title: Trudi AI
proj3.description: A website to connect renters with homeowners. Features include core internal components, Storybook integration, and AI-powered voice response system.

proj4.title: Easy Reporting
proj4.description: A website that allows users to report office issues such as machinery or equipment malfunction, with integrated database and reporting features.
